title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning Market Making: Lessons from Loss Function Experimentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09012v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Market makers play a vital role in ensuring efficient trade within financial markets. Recent literature has delved into training market-making systems using reinforcement learning. This paper delves into the impact of various loss function formulations on risk management behavior within reinforcement-based market making. Through empirical evaluation, we contrast profit-maximizing strategies with risk-averse approaches, finding that penalties for inventory and cash management foster more resilient and adaptable market-making strategies. Our results underscore the significance of striking a balance between profit maximization and risk management in algorithmic trading, providing actionable insights for refining strategies in practical settings.

translated_title: 迈向稳健的强化学习做市：来自损失函数实验的启示
translated_abstract: 做市商在确保金融市场高效交易方面发挥着至关重要的作用。近年来的文献已深入探讨使用强化学习训练做市系统。本文研究了各种损失函数形式对基于强化学习的做市中风险管理行为的影响。通过实证评估，我们对比了利润最大化策略与风险规避方法，发现对库存和现金管理施加惩罚能够培养出更具韧性和适应性的做市策略。我们的结果强调了在算法交易中平衡利润最大化与风险管理的重要性，为在实际环境中改进策略提供了切实可行的见解。
tldr: 该论文通过实证实验发现，在强化学习做市中，采用对库存和现金管理施加惩罚的损失函数能够培养出更稳健、更具适应性的做市策略，凸显了在算法交易中平衡利润最大化与风险管理的关键意义。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows that in reinforcement learning market making, loss functions incorporating penalties on inventory and cash management foster more robust and adaptable strategies, underscoring the importance of balancing profit maximization and risk management in algorithmic trading.
